name: Stem
description: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and Claude can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and visualize the whole brain at awase.dev/stem. The same memory is available to every MCP-compatible tool the user connects, so context never has to be re-explained. Free tier included; storage tiers are opt-in.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stem to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stem to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://awase.dev/stem. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stem MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stem provides these MCP tools: forget, graph, link, recall, and remember.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stem?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stem in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Stem requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stem is developed by Awase LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
